title: A No-Code Toolchain for Validating Wearable Motion Sensing Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.28027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Designing e-textiles for human motion sensing often demands engineering expertise for sensor data processing, typically relying on advanced machine learning methods. In addition, validating designs---collecting sensor measurements and ground-truth motion data, training and testing machine learning models, and iterating on sensor layouts---can be labour- and time-intensive. To address this, we present a no-code toolchain that enables non-technical users to validate system designs efficiently. The tool provides three key capabilities: (1) deriving ground-truth joint-angle measurements from webcam recordings; (2) training and testing machine learning models using collected sensor data; and (3) visualising and analysing motion sensing performance and sensor layout choices. translated_title: 一种用于验证可穿戴运动感知系统的无代码工具链
translated_abstract: 为人体运动感知设计电子织物（e-textiles）通常需要传感器数据处理方面的工程专业知识，且往往依赖先进的机器学习方法。此外，验证设计——收集传感器测量数据和真实运动数据、训练和测试机器学习模型、以及迭代调整传感器布局——可能既费力又耗时。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种无代码工具链，使非技术用户能够高效地验证系统设计。该工具提供三项关键功能：(1) 从网络摄像头录像中提取关节角度的真实测量值；(2) 使用收集的传感器数据训练和测试机器学习模型；(3) 可视化和分析运动感知性能及传感器布局选择。我们的工具只需简单、低成本的设置，并能在几分钟内生成测试报告。我们进行了一项用户研究以验证该工具链的可用性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需编程的无代码工具链，让非技术用户能够通过摄像头提取真实关节角度数据、训练和测试机器学习模型并可视化分析传感器布局，从而低成本、高效率地验证可穿戴电子织物运动感知系统的设计。
en_tdlr: A no-code toolchain that enables non-technical users to efficiently validate wearable motion sensing system designs by deriving ground-truth joint angles from webcam recordings, training and testing ML models, and visualizing sensing performance and sensor layout choices.
